error_rows: E_VIEW_OWNER

an agent session commits, includes, excludes, undoes, closes or proposes in a view another session owns, or acts in work, the human's view; a view with no owner takes a commit, which claims it, and refuses the rest
fork the view, or include its changes into your own view; an agent with no view writes to work-<actor>, never to the human's work
E_VIEW_EXISTS
a view of that name exists
pick a free name, or fork the view under another name
E_VIEW_CLOSED
the view is closed and takes no write, include, exclude, undo or propose, except the undo of its close; or an approval names a proposal version that a close of its view withdrew
reopen it with rdy_view {op: "undo", view, target: <the close op>}, or fork it; a withdrawn proposal stays withdrawn, so propose again after the reopen
E_HAS_DEPENDENTS
changes in the view depend on a change you exclude (each is an issue)
exclude them too, or pass cascade: true
E_DEPS_MISSING
a proposal subset leaves out changes its members depend on (each is an issue)
add the missing changes to rdy_propose's changes
E_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED
an issue names a conflict the proposal version does not resolve
write the block from the version you want, then propose again
E_BLOCKING_TENSION
an issue names an undismissed blocking tension that the landing would put into canon

resolve each as the fix names for its kind (a change to a side; a repin helps a stale citation, never a semantic tension), or dismiss it with rdy_resolve {tension, dismiss: {reason}} (a reviewer of another actor, or a human); rdy_tensions {involving: <change>} lists them, a form only this landing gives with its proposal
E_SELF_REVIEW

rdy_resolve dismisses a blocking tension or one a reviewer advised to block, or rdy_review_submit judges a pair, and the session's actor wrote a side of it (another run of the same actor is not independent)
a reviewer of another actor, or a human, dismisses the tension; a reviewer of another actor judges the pair
E_REVIEW_INVALID

rdy_review_submit: the verdict fails its schema (a verdict other than tension or no_tension, a citation on another block, an empty or over-long note, a tension with no citation, more than 20 citations, a severity other than advisory or blocking, advice on a no_tension, advice to block without a reason)
send the corrected payload
E_REVIEW_STALE
rdy_review_submit: the case hash is no longer current (a side changed, landed or left every view), or a verdict already settled the request (the message names it)
call rdy_review_next again
E_PROPOSAL_MOVED
a newer version exists, or a landing since the version changed blocks it writes, or the project requires proposals on the current canon
propose again; a human approves the latest P-x@n
E_UNDO_BLOCKED
an undo would leave the view inconsistent (each blocking op is an issue)
undo with cascade: true, or undo the dependent ops first
E_UNDO_LANDING
an undo would bring back or remove work that has landed
a landing is undone by a revoking decision (rdy_revoke); when only a dep of the change landed, include the change directly with rdy_view include, which adds the landed dep
E_NOTHING_TO_UNDO
you have no undoable op of your own on the view
name an op with target (rdy_view show lists them)
E_INTENT_EXPIRED
renewing or withdrawing an expired intent
post a new one
E_ALT_UNCHOSEN
a member view proposed without naming its set and member
pass alternatives: {set, chosen} with your own member
E_ALT_MEMBER

a view in two open sets, a member that is not an open view, a chosen member that is not the proposing view's, a set that is no longer open, a change bound to another member (it alone held it when it joined the set), or a change bound in two open sets
propose from the bound member's view with its pick; for a change bound in two open sets, exclude it and propose without it
E_ALT_CHOSEN
a proposal carries a change of a member that lost a chosen set, and records no decision that supersedes or refines the choice
land it with a decision that supersedes or refines the choice decision (rdy_supersede, or rdy_decide with refines)
E_DAEMON_START
the daemon couldn't be started or reached
read the last lines of .rdy/run/daemon.log it cites; run rdy serve in the foreground to see why
E_DAEMON_VERSION
another binary version's daemon has clients
close them, or rdy serve --stop
E_DAEMON_GONE
the daemon closed mid-request
check rdy_overview or rdy status; a write may or may not have committed; it is not retried
E_BRIEF_REQUIRED
a write touches stable content and cites no briefing, or one that does not cover the block

retry with the token of the briefing the error carries
on a readiness issue: exclude the change (rdy_view exclude), rdy_brief the block, and write it again
E_BRIEF_STALE
the cited briefing is unknown, or a block it recorded moved in the write's view
read what moved, then retry with the token of the briefing the error carries
W_BRIEF_STALE
a write to drafts cited a stale or unknown briefing (it went ahead)
brief again before the next write if the moved blocks matter
E_PAGE_STALE

a page cursor (the next of a cut rdy_brief, rdy_read or rdy_search) is unknown to this session, or what it pages (a briefing, a read or a search) moved since its first page, or the search query differs
the read, briefing or search moved; start again without a cursor
W_CONFIG_UNKNOWN

a config file (.rdy/local.yaml, the project config or the user config) holds a key rdy does not know (such as a typo), or a known key in a file where rdy does not read it; the warning names the file it belongs in; rdy ignores the key; reported by rdy config --show-origin, rdy status, every CLI command and rdy_session
fix the key's spelling (the fix names the nearest known key), move it to the file the warning names, or remove it
W_PACK_SEVERITY
a pack lowers unjustified_change
remove the unjustified_change severity from the pack
W_UNAPPLIED_DECISION
a proposal creates a decision that no content applies in its view, and the decision does not set needs_content: false; rdy_propose and rdy propose report it, and it never refuses the proposal
write the content that carries it with implements: <decision>, or link that content to it with decided_by; for a process ruling, set needs_content: false
E_SITE
the live site has no daemon, cannot bind its port, has reached its profile-site limit, or is stopping
follow the error's fix
W_SITE_LAN

the live site is open to the network (serve.site_lan is on): anyone who can reach the address can read the docs; or the LAN address could not be bound, and the site stays on this machine; rdy_site and rdy site carry it with the link
set serve.site_lan to false to keep the site on this machine; when the site already stays on it, follow the warning's own fix
W_SITE_PROFILE
a profile-only site is open, or its profile is no longer in canon
relay the warning; use rdy site for the full source link, or restore the profile
W_DIAGRAM_INVALID

A Mermaid diagram does not parse, or is over one of rdy's size bounds, so the render shows it as its code block. The render never fails for it. The bounds limit the source's bytes, its statements, its nesting depth, the length of one arrow, and its arrows and groups. A longer or labelled arrow counts as more than one. A state note and each boundary between concurrent regions also count as one arrow. A smaller diagram, split into parts, or shorter arrows fix a bound.
correct the diagram source
W_DIAGRAM_UNSUPPORTED
A Mermaid diagram whose header keyword names a type that rdy does not draw shows its source as a code block.
use a flowchart, class, sequence or state diagram, or keep it as source
W_DIAGRAM_FAILED
The drawn SVG of a diagram fails rdy's checks, so the render shows its source as a code block.
simplify the diagram, or report it as a bug in rdy, with the diagram's source
E_DUMP
the file is not a dump this rdy reads, the dump is damaged, the loaded project fails fsck, or a clone's dump is older than store format 12
pass a file rdy dump wrote; a damaged dump is never repaired: dump the project again; for an older dump, load it, then clone the loaded project
E_STORE_FORMAT
this rdy does not open the store as it is: an older or newer store format, an unknown store feature, an invalid feature manifest, or a store that needs an upgrade
follow the refusal's fix: open the project with the rdy it names, dump and load, or run rdy upgrade
E_STORE_READ_ONLY
an unsupported feature allows reads only, or its store has no lock file
open the project with the rdy build named by the refusal
E_UPGRADE_MOVED
the store changed after the upgrade was planned
run rdy_upgrade with dry_run true, or rdy upgrade --dry-run, then retry
E_UPGRADE_BACKUP
the backup is incomplete, differs from the store, or contains a link or special file
follow the reported backup fix, then retry
E_UPGRADE_FAILED
the upgrade batch is durable, but the store check or fsck failed
stop the daemon and restore the backup before retrying
W_SKELETON_MISSING
a doc lacks a required section of its doc_type; reported once per doc per session, and later writes count the repeats in warnings_repeated
add the section, or give the doc a doc_type without it (page)
E_EXCEPTION_OPEN
an approval names a version whose exceptions have no answer
answer each exception card first
E_PROPOSAL_NOT_READY
the proposal version fails readiness; issues name each failed check
fix each issue and propose again: rdy_propose / rdy propose
E_ITEM_MOVED
the item changed since its card was shown
show the fresh card and ask again
W_CARD_WORDS
a decision or question lacks its card words, or they are too long
add a short title, a one-line why and, for a question, two to four options
E_REDACTION_TARGET
Cannot redact {target}: {cause}.
Use a block id, id@full-version-hash, or blob:full-manifest-hash.
E_REDACTION_LIMIT
A redaction or dump-chain load exceeds {limit}.

For a redaction, select fewer targets and run the dry run again. For a stopped load, stop at another place, or load the whole chain with no stop. For a holder load, keep the dump chain and the holder it came from; this rdy cannot load it.
E_REDACTION_REASON
The redaction needs a reason and a reason class.
Use secret, personal, legal, or retraction, with a reason of 1 to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
E_REDACTION_STALE
The redaction report changed after the request was recorded.
Record a new request, show its report, and ask for approval again.
E_REDACTION_HUMAN
Content removal needs a person's approval.
Show the redaction card and relay the person's answer, or approve from the CLI as a human.
E_REDACTION_PENDING
Content removal was authorized but has not finished.
Close the project and reopen it to finish the removal. Do not delete the log.
E_REDACTION_CORRUPT
The redaction record does not authorize the missing payload at {segment}:{offset}.
Keep the store unchanged and inspect it with rdy fsck.
E_REDACTED_STATE
This read state predates content removal.
Read the project again, or run the dump again.
E_REDACTED
Content removed by redaction {hash}.
Read the redaction details in the source history.
E_REDACTION_BUDGET
The output budget is too small for the redaction warning.
Increase max_tokens, or propose fewer redaction requests at once.
W_REDACTION_COPIES
This removes bytes from this store. It cannot erase exports, renders, dumps, clones, published files, working copies, backups, or filesystem snapshots.
W_REDACTION_INVENTORY
Dumps, clones, exports, renders, and published versions may hold copies. Their locations are unknown to rdy.
W_REDACTION_QUOTES

Quote matches use complete source strings. Partial quotes may still hold content. Snapshot issue lists and summaries, review citations, tension advice, answer notes and change-plan versions are not erased.
W_REDACTION_REUSE
This store will refuse these object and chunk hashes on later writes. This can block an identical restore or a file that shares a removed chunk.
W_REDACTION_QUARANTINE
Quarantine files may hold the content. Redaction does not remove them. A person can run rdy fsck --clean-quarantine.
W_REDACTION_SECRET
Rotate or revoke the secret. Redaction does not undo its exposure.
E_SIGNING_KEY_MISSING
{setting} is not set
set {setting} in the user config or .rdy/local.yaml
E_SIGNING_KEY_TYPE
{key} has unsupported signing key type {type}
set an ssh-ed25519 or sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com key
E_NO_AGENT
the SSH agent could not sign: {cause}
check SSH_AUTH_SOCK and the configured key, then try again
E_SIG_INVALID
signature {hash} is invalid
check the source of this signature; it may be damaged or forged
E_SIG_OBJECT_MISMATCH
signature {hash} does not match its subject
run rdy sign for this subject, or refuse the record
W_SIG_UNKNOWN_KEY
key {key} is not trusted for {principal} in {namespace}
add the key and principal to signing.allowed_signers
W_SIGNING_FAILED
the act was saved without signatures: {code}: {message}
fix the signing error, then run rdy sign
E_ACTOR_UNBOUND
the session actor is not a hub actor
set an actor in the hub's human, agent or ci form, then try again
E_REMOTE_REQUIRED
no remote was selected
pass --remote, or configure one share remote or one remote
E_REMOTE_EXISTS
a share remote already exists
change its mode before adding another share remote
E_UPSTREAM_ORIGIN
the request destination is not trusted for {install}
use the install origin; for a publish upload, add its destination to the pinned origins of this install (hub.installs.<install>.pinned_origins)
E_UPSTREAM_TOKEN
the hub token has an invalid form
sign in to this install again
E_UPSTREAM_AUTH
sign-in is required for {install}
start a new sign-in for this install
E_UPSTREAM_PROTOCOL
the hub reply does not match the client contract
check that this rdy version supports the hub's API
E_UPSTREAM_TRANSPORT
the hub request failed
check the install address, network and CA setting, then try again
E_UPSTREAM_REFUSED
the hub refused the request
check the account's access on the hub before trying again
E_UPSTREAM_UNCERTAIN
the hub request may have completed
check its state on the hub before trying again; for a publish upload, check push {push} on the hub
E_UPSTREAM_CONFIRM_HOST
the install host has not been confirmed
show the sign-in card, then relay the answer with its card_hash
E_UPSTREAM_CA
the configured CA file cannot be used
set ca_file to an absolute path to a valid PEM certificate bundle in user config
E_UPSTREAM_KEY_PROOF
the agent's key proof is invalid
check the configured public key and SSH agent, then bind again
E_UPSTREAM_ACTOR_CLAIM
the hub refused the actor claim
check the current account handle and session actor, then try again
W_UPSTREAM_HANDLE_CHANGED
the hub handle changed from {old} to {new}
use human:{new} for this install
W_UPSTREAM_SIGNOUT_LOCAL
the local credential was removed; hub sign-out was not confirmed
end the credential on the hub if it is still active
E_BAD_RECORD

a sync batch has an invalid object, frame or header, an unlisted dependency, an unneeded prerequisite, a root tag that is not in the batch or its prerequisites, a dependency cycle or a repeated object
request this stream again; run rdy fsck at its source
E_UNRESOLVED_REF
an upload needs an object that was not supplied
send the missing object with its dependencies
E_STREAM_TRUNCATED
a sync batch's trailer is missing or does not match
request the complete stream again
E_STREAM_PURPOSE
a sync batch has a purpose this call did not request
request a tag_history stream
E_REPO_MISMATCH
a sync batch names a different repo from its holder
use the holder for the stream's repo
E_DUMP_CHAIN
The dump files do not form a chain, or the predecessor does not match this store.
Pass a full dump and its increments in order, or start a new chain.
E_LOAD_STOP
The requested stop does not name one batch end in the dump chain.
Name a landing, a tag, or a batch end that the chain holds.
W_STOP_BEFORE_REDACTION
This store stops before redaction apply {apply} of its source, approved by {actor} at landing {landing}. It holds {held} removed payloads again, and {removed} stay removed.
Propose the redaction of the listed targets again, and have a person approve it.
E_PLAN_OPEN
the version's change plan has open items on stable content or unanswered tension items
close or defer each item, and answer each tension item with confirm or dismiss: rdy_plan / rdy plan
E_POLICY_HUMAN
the authority policy needs a person for the version
show the card to the person and relay their answer: rdy_pending, then rdy_answer
E_COVERAGE_LOWERED
the version lowers a page's or the corpus's coverage
see what lowered it with rdy_coverage / rdy coverage, then tie the new content to what it describes
E_PLAN_ITEM
<id> is not an item of the change plan for <scope>
read the plan with rdy_plan / rdy plan and pass an item id it lists
E_DEFERRAL_OPEN
<n> deferrals of P-x@n have no answer
answer the deferral card first: defer:P-x@n
W_PLAN_OPEN
<n> change-plan items are open
close or defer each item: rdy_plan / rdy plan
W_PLAN_ANSWER_LAPSED
the answer to <id> lapsed: <block> changed
answer the item again
W_REFLECTS_NO_CODE
no linked checkout; rdy records no code state for <id>
set code_paths, then repin it with code: true
E_FROZEN
a write changes an accepted or rejected decision beyond its tracking fields, or beyond its pins and reaffirmed field through a reaffirm op, or a conflict on one cannot be resolved by an edit

take the landed side of a conflict (rdy view resolve <view> <id> --landed; rdy_view {op: "resolve", block, landed: true}), or write a new decision that supersedes or revokes it. For a suspect accepted decision that still holds, re-affirm it with a reaffirm op instead.
E_HELD_BY_READER
the project store is still open in this process through a read state of an earlier open
release the earlier read state, then try again
E_PUBLICATION_REFERENCE
a public profile refers to blocks outside its selection
Include the target docs or remove these references. Run the publication check again.
W_PUBLICATION_REFERENCE
an org profile has references outside its selection, or a live public profile has blocked references
follow the warning's own fix

reason.description: The reason in plain words, 1 to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. It is kept as audit text.

reason_class.description: Why the content goes: secret, personal, legal or retraction.

targets.description: Selectors: a block id (every stored version), id@<64-hex version hash> (one version), or blob:<64-hex manifest hash>. 1 to 256, each at most 256 bytes.

level.description: The config level to change: project (.rdy.yaml, the default), local (.rdy/local.yaml) or user. add, rm and set_mode.

mode.description: share (the project's shared line; at most one) or publish. add and set_mode.

name.description: The remote's name: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', a letter or digit first. add, rm and set_mode.

url.description: The remote's HTTPS URL. add only.

out.description: The directory to write: absolute, or relative to the project directory. It must be new, empty, or a site rdy rendered before (replaced as a whole).

profile.description: A publication profile id or key in the selected scope, or implicit:org for every doc. Selects whole docs and folders for local output.

advised_digest.description: The advised_digest rdy_propose or rdy_read P-x@n gave with the advised tensions the person was shown.

evidence.description: The person's words, quoted (needed: your session relays them).

proposal.description: The exact proposal version the person was shown: P-x@n.

question.description: The question the person was asked.

session_ref.description: Where the person said it, e.g. the chat session (default: mcp).

tensions.description: Only these advised tensions (tn-…); leave out to accept every advised one of the version.

session_ref.description: Where the person said it, e.g. the chat session (needs evidence; default: mcp).

block.description: The block that names the entity (c-… from a suggestion's block).

entity.description: The entity it names (from a suggestion's target).

accept.description: A person's answer to the advice on a proposal's semantic tensions: accept it, relayed with their words. Pass this alone.

dismiss.description:

change.

mention.description:
A passing mention to dismiss or restore: the block and the entity a suggestion names.
Pass this or tension.

restore.description: Restore a dismissed mention, with a reason. A tension is not restored.

scope.description: Where the mention is checked: canon or a view. Defaults to your view.

tension.description:
The tension to dismiss: tn-<12 hex> from rdy_tensions (a unique prefix works). Pass this

kind.description: The review kind: tension (the only kind until M3).

block.description: One of the two block ids of the case.

note.description: What in the block disagrees, 1 to 2000 characters.

case_hash.description: case_hash from rdy_review_next: the case you read.

citations.description: What disagrees: {block, note} per block that takes part; a tension needs 1 to 20.

reason.description: With severity blocking: why the tension should block, 1 to 2000 characters.

request.description: The request from rdy_review_next: rq-<12 hex>.

severity.description: advisory (default) or blocking: on a tension, advise a person to make it block. Advice gates nothing until a person accepts it.

brief.description: The briefing token from rdy_brief. Required when the write touches stable content.

intent.description: The intent (rdy_intent, in-<hex>) this change is made under: recorded on the change.

parent.description: The doc, section or folder to record the revoking decision in (id, key or path). Omit parent to record it in the decision home, or at the project root when the project names none.

block_type.description: Describe one block type; omit to list all types.

brief.description: Add a briefing over this page's hits and over the blocks of the entity sheets; cite its base.token to write those blocks.

changed_since.description: Keep blocks whose version changed since a version (e.g. 1.2.0), tag:<version> or landing:<id>.

coverage_below.description: Keep hits whose block coverage score is under this (0 to 100).

describes.description: Keep blocks with a describes link to this block.

exclude_history.description: Leave out matches inside a superseded, rejected or revoked decision (they carry history: true).

governed_by.description: Keep blocks this decision governs: through decided_by, implements, or the decision's affects.

lifecycle.description: Keep blocks whose lifecycle, as inherited, is draft, stable or deprecated.

linked_to.description: Keep blocks with any link or reference to or from this block.

max_tokens.description: The budget for this page of matches (default 4000).

mentions.description: Keep blocks that name an entity by name or alias: linked (tied to it) or unlinked (not linked yet).

page.description: Continue a cut search: its next cursor, with the same query, flags and scope.

path.description: Keep blocks under this doc or folder path (whole segments), e.g. "guides".

query.description: The text to find; with regex: true, a pattern (Rust regex syntax, at most 1024 bytes).

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression (default false: literal text).

scope.description: "canon", a view name, "tag:<version>", "landing:<id>", "proposal:P-<id>@<n>" or "view:<name>". Defaults to the session view.

sort.description: "coverage": list the hits with the lowest coverage first. Leave out for the default order.

suspect.description: Keep only blocks with an open suspect.

tension.description: Keep only blocks involved in an open tension.

traits.description: Keep blocks whose type has one of these traits: normative, informative, defines, describes, asset, structural.

types.description: Keep these block types (any of them), e.g. ["code"].

actor.description: Who is acting: this agent's own actor, e.g. "agent:designer" (a human actor is refused).

areas.description: Areas this session watches for landings, persisted with its inbox cursor; [] clears them (the areas of the blocks you change apply).

run.description: The run this agent belongs to; also the default view name.

view.description: Override the default view for writes. A reader may pass "canon" to read canon by default.

kind.description: approval, relay or tag. Default: your own kind for a person (approval or tag), relay for an agent.

target.description: The landing or tag to sign: a landing id (a hash or a unique prefix of 6 or more), or tag:<version>.

only.description: Serve canon through this profile on a separate port. Requires profile and scope canon. This changes presentation, not source access.

profile.description: A publication profile id or key in this scope, or implicit:org. Omit it for all docs.

scope.description: canon (default), a version as tag:<version>, a view name or view:<name>, or proposal:P-x@n (P-x follows its latest version). A view or proposal renders in review mode and updates as it changes.

file.description: The batch file: absolute, or relative to the project directory. A name of - is an ordinary file name.

repo_id.description: Refuse a batch of another repo: 32 hex digits.

brief.description: The briefing token from rdy_brief. Required when the write touches stable content.

effective_from.description: When the decision takes effect (RFC 3339); defaults to when it is recorded.

fields.description: Pack-defined decision fields, e.g. {"key": "FW-E3", "disposition": "built in M2c3"}: rdy_schema decision lists them; validated against the pack as rdy_write validates fields. intent.description: The intent (rdy_intent, in-<hex>) this change is made under: recorded on the change.

max_tokens.description: The budget for the response's consequences.

parent.description: The doc, section or folder to record the decision in (id, key or path). Omit parent to record it in the decision home, or at the project root when the project names none.

recommend.description: What you recommend the person does with this decision: confirm or reject. Give recommend_reason with it.

recommend_reason.description: The reason for the recommendation, in one line of 200 characters or fewer.

title.description: The card's plain-words title: what a person is asked to confirm, in 80 characters or fewer. A decision with no title gets a W_CARD_WORDS warning.

why.description: The card's one line on why a person must answer, in 160 characters or fewer.

decision.description: The new decision. It inherits the old decision's affects, depends_on, conditional_on and refines unless you give that kind; an empty list drops it.

intent.description: The intent (rdy_intent, in-<hex>) this change is made under; used when decision has none.

part.description: The words of the old decision that this one retires; omit to supersede all of it.

evidence.description: The person's words that ask for the tag, quoted (1 to 2000 characters).

landing.description: The landing to name (a hash or a prefix of 6 or more); default: canon's head.

question.description: The question you asked the person.

session_ref.description: The chat session the person spoke in (default: mcp).

version.description: The new version, e.g. "v1.2.0": above every version, on the current version's landing or a later one.

area.description: Only tensions that involve a block in this area (one of rdy_schema's areas).

involving.description:
Only tensions that involve this block (id, key or path) or this change (a hex prefix of
at least 6 digits).

kind.description:
Only this kind: edit_collision, fork, premise_shift, area_overlap, duplicate_definition,
unjustified_change, deprecated_reference, value_disagreement, restatement_drift or
semantic.

max_tokens.description: Cut the answer to about this many tokens (blocking tensions come first).

reviews.description:
Also list every dismissal review: who dismissed which tension, why, and whether the
dismissal still holds.

inflight (default: every tension), canon (only tensions whose sides are all canon) or a
view name (tensions with a change side in that view).

severity.description: Only this severity: blocking or advisory.

view.description: Only tensions with a change side in this view (the same as a scope that is a view).

depth.description: How many steps of lineage to walk, 1 to 8 (default 3). A value outside that range is refused, a negative one too.

detail.description: Add the recorded evidence: authored options, sealed plans, landing evidence and the whole re-affirmation record.

id.description: A block id or a path. Also `id@version` or a whole ref line `[id@version] …`, read under that version.

max_tokens.description: The budget of the reply, at most 100000 (default 1000). A cut drops whole decision rows, deepest first, and names each in frontier.

scope.description: "canon", a view name (an existing view, or your session's), "tag:<version>", "landing:<id>", "proposal:P-<id>@<n>" or "view:<name>". Defaults to the session view.

dry_run.description: true: inspect the upgrade without writes. Default false.

actor.description: The new owner's actor: human:<name>, agent:<name>[/<name>], or ci:<repo_id>/<name>.

run.description: The owner's run. Omit it for an owner with no run.

a.description: compare: the first scope (default: your view).

base.description: create: the landing or version to start from (default: canon's head).

block.description: resolve: the block whose conflict to resolve (id, key or path).

cascade.description: exclude and undo: also exclude the changes that depend on these (default false).

changes.description: include, exclude and replay: the change ids. Include brings the changes' dependencies with them; exclude refuses while others depend on them unless cascade is true; replay (at least one) brings none.

evidence.description: own and close with stale: the person's words, quoted. Without them an agent session is refused (E_PERMISSION).

landed.description: resolve: true takes the landed side of a conflict on an accepted or rejected decision: the view then reads canon's frozen version (required).

name.description: create and fork: the new view's name; close, own and show: the view.

op.description: create, fork, include, exclude, replay, compare, list, show, close, own, resolve, undo. own and close with stale are a person's acts: relay their words with evidence.

owner.description: own: the new owner as {actor, run?}.

pin.description: create: pin the view to its base, so landings do not rebase it (default false).

question.description: own and close with stale: the question the person answered.

reason.description: close: why, recorded on the view.

session_ref.description: own and close with stale: the chat session the person spoke in (default mcp).

stale.description: list: mark views idle after this many days; close: close the views idle that long.

target.description: undo: the op to undo (default: your newest undoable op on the view).

view.description: include, exclude, replay, resolve, undo, show: the view to act on (default: your own). You need to own it for include, exclude, replay, resolve, close and undo.

OneOrMany.description: llst1: one text, or a list of them.

code.description:
true records the code state of each written block with reflects globs. Missing: false;
false is refused.

sources.description:
The sources (S-…) the change follows: an id, key or path each, or the $name of a source
created in this write. Missing: none.

brief.description: The briefing token from rdy_brief. Required when the write touches stable content.

implements.description: The decisions this change carries out: an id, key or path, or a list of them.

intent.description: The intent (rdy_intent, in-<hex>) this change is made under: recorded on the change.

max_tokens.description: The budget for the response's consequences.

reflects.description: Pass one of implements, editorial or reflects. reflects is {sources?: [source id, key or path], code?: true}. A source created in this write counts if the final state holds it. code: true records the code state of each written block with reflects globs.
